title.narrative: El Obeid Basic Education improvement project

description.narrative:
This project aims to assist in the provision of schooling in the Diocese of El Obeid, Sudan.
The on-going conflict in South Kordofan and Darfur has caused many families to be displaced to north Kordofan state (and other safe locations in Sudan). Among the displaced are school children. The kids are being hosted by local community schools which were already over-enrolled and in need of improved facilities. Most of these schools are built from local materials and have no seating, latrines, water supplies and other basic amenities needed for education. Enrolment is limited but at the same time the numbers has over-stretch the limited facilities already in place.
The government provides teachers and some provisions where parents come together to help improve the education of such children – but is limited due to the level of the demand. The Diocese of El Obeid has also been involved in supplementary support to the education needs. The Dioceses has invested quite appropriately in the schools infrastructure, but has to cater for the running of the Church managed schools with high recurrent cost needed. CAFOD works with the Diocese in helping ease the burden on parents, regarding the cost for the provision of quality education. CAFOD, for example has been subsiding costs for the Church schools as well as costs incurred by the vulnerable parents through provision of school uniforms, teaching/learning materials, teacher training and water tankering.
On-going CAFOD work on livelihood (a separate grant from CAFOD and FAO) with target vulnerable parents and the general community of the target areas is to ensure parents are able to contribute towards the recurrent costs for the Church schools.
